title: Kalavarapadi Ne Kondala Vaipu Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: కలవరపడి నే కొండల వైపు నా కన్నులెత్తుదునా

నీవే నా ఆత్మదాహము తీర్చినా వెంబడించిన బండవు
సకలము చేయగల నీ వైపేనా కన్నులెత్తి చూచెదా
సకలము చేయగల నీ వైపే నా కన్నులెత్తి చూచెదా

english: Kalavarapadi ne kondala vaipu naa kannuletthuduna
Kondala vaipu naa kanuletthi koduvatho nenu kumiledhana
Neeve naa aathma daahamu theerchina vembadinchina bandhavu
Sakalamu cheyagala nee vaipena kannuletthi chucheda
Sakalamu cheyagala nee vaipe naa kannuletthi chucheda
Yesayya needu mukhamu chucheda paravashinchi paadeda
Yesayya needu mukham chucheda paravashinchi paadeda
translation: Should I lift up my eyes toward the hills in worry and anxiety?
Lifting my eyes to the hills, should I suffer and pine away in lack?
When You are with me, and You are my support,
You are mine, You are the one,
You are the Rock that followed me and quenched my spiritual thirst.
You are the treasure-trove of all grace, the mine of all riches,
I will lift up my eyes and look only towards You, who can do all things.
Upon Mount Zion, which can never be shaken,
Beholding Your holy face, I will sing out in absolute ecstasy.
intro: Kalavarapadi Ne Kondala Vaipu is the latest Telugu Christian song. This song was released on May 29, 2026, through YESAYYA SONGS YouTube Channel.
